title: Provide a supported shader source and SPIR-V measurement hook
body: Isolating the glyph text-scene compile regression required temporary instrumentation in ShaderCompiler.cpp to dump each compiled GLSL/SPIR-V pair under VIXEN_SHADER_DUMP_DIR, followed by a manual spirv-dis script for instruction/function/loop/specialization-constant counts. The instrumentation had to be removed after measurement. Provide a declared diagnostic capture and metric path so generator regressions can be compared without editing the production compiler for one run.
